slot.brief: Find the intervals in which a given polynomial or rational function is increasing/decreasing by examining f'(x)

stem: The function $f(x)=x^3+3x^2-9x$ is increasing on which interval(s)?

verdicts.working: f'(x)=3x^2+6x-9=3(x+3)(x-1), which is positive for x<-3 and x>1. Thus the function is increasing on the intervals in (B).

working:
$f'(x)=3x^2+6x-9=3(x+3)(x-1)$.
$f'(x)>0$ for $x<-3$ or $x>1$.
Hence $f$ is increasing on $(-\infty,-3)\cup(1,\infty)$.
